name: Psychedelic Society of Arkansas
description: Pronounced “SOAR” (the P is silent). A statewide 501(c)(3) promoting education, risk reduction, and community outreach around psychedelics and plant medicine, with local chapters across Arkansas.

name: Natural State Mental Health
description: A 501(c)(4) advocacy organization working to pass legislation for regulated, supervised therapeutic access to psychedelic plants in Arkansas.

name: Psychedelic Society of the Ozarks
description: A Springfield, Missouri 501(c)(3) dedicated to education, community-building, and harm reduction around psychedelics and plant medicine. Hosts the annual Psychedelic Freedom Conference.

name: Psychedelic STL
description: A St. Louis community working to build a knowledgeable, safe, and inclusive community around psychedelics as tools for mental wellness, personal growth, and spiritual insight — demystifying psychedelics, educating the public, and advocating for their legal and conscientious use.

name: Psychedelic Society of Kansas City
description: A community for education and discussion about psychedelics, offering a safe, inclusive place to learn about psychedelic medicine and share personal stories. Monthly meetups feature keynote speakers from drug policy experts to visionary artists.

name: Lawrence Psychedelic Society
description: Education, resources, and local support for Kansans interested in psychedelics. Presents the Kansas Consciousness Conference.

name: Oklahoma Psychedelic Collective
description: A Tulsa 501(c)(3) advancing ethical, evidence-based psychedelic education, research, and therapy. Hosts the Open Plains Psychedelic Symposium, a Psychedelic Salon, and Second Saturday socials.
